subject: general
question: In 2023, the Government of India proposed 'Amrit Dharohar Scheme' to be implemented over the next ____________ to encourage optimal use of wetlands and enhance bio-diversity, carbon stock, ecotourism opportunities and income generation for local communities.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Three Years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Amrit Dharohar Scheme** was proposed by the **Government of India** in **2023**.
 
• It is designed to be implemented over the next **three years** to achieve sustainable management of **wetlands in India**.
 
• The scheme aims to encourage the **optimal use of wetlands**, which are crucial ecosystems for biodiversity and climate resilience.
 
• It seeks to enhance **biodiversity, carbon stock**, and **ecotourism opportunities**, while also generating income for **local communities**.
 
• **Wetlands** play a critical role in maintaining ecological balance by acting as **natural water purifiers**, mitigating **floods**, and serving as **carbon sinks**.
 
• The scheme aligns with India’s commitment to environmental goals under global frameworks like the **Ramsar Convention** and the **United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**.
 
• The initiative emphasizes the involvement of **local communities** in the sustainable management of wetlands, ensuring their active participation in conservation efforts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Wetlands and their Importance**__

 __
 
• **Wetlands** are ecosystems where water covers the soil or is present at or near the surface for varying periods of time.
 
• They are biodiversity hotspots that provide habitat for various species of **flora and fauna**.
 
• Wetlands are critical for **climate change mitigation** as they act as significant **carbon sinks**.
 
• They also support livelihoods by offering opportunities for **fishing, farming, and tourism**.
 
 
 
• **Ramsar Convention**__
 
 
• The **Ramsar Convention** is an international treaty signed in **1971** for the conservation and sustainable use of wetlands.
 
• India is a signatory to this convention and has a total of **75 Ramsar sites** as of 2023.
 
• The Ramsar sites in India include **Sundarbans, Chilika Lake, Loktak Lake, and Keoladeo National Park**.
